TEXT: [FI] A certain day in Akihabara.
[FI] The maid cafe, "Pretty Garden Chapter 10".

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI_KAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ladies and gentlemen!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Now then, we truly thank you for attending our 
"Pretty Garden" and...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] "Otaku Girls Unite" collaboration offline meetup. 
Welcome one and all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Once again, I am the organizer, Saori Bajeena.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: [FI] Also an organizer, Makishima Kaori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Well now, I didn't think we would have this many 
people participating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Contrary to what I thought, this has become a 
large-scale party.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
[FI] It looks like there are other circles doing offline 
meetups, so do your best not to cause trouble for 
the other customers.

SPEAKER: SPK_EVERYBODY
TEXT: [FI] Kay~~

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: [FI] Alright.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Now we have a message from the head maid, 
Kirara-san of "Pretty Garden Chapter 10", who has 
let us use her amazing venue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
[FI] Everyone~, I'm Hoshino Kirara♪ Welcome to the 
10th opening of this store.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
[FI] We have prepared a lot of tasty food, various 
drinks, and cute maids so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: [FI] Please enjoy yourself☆

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_GIRLS
TEXT: [FI] Uhyoooooo!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
[FI] If you enjoy my cafe, you can always review it on 
a blog or something, y'know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: [FI] You're doing well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: [FI] I am the head maid, after all☆

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...She's the same as ever.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Doesn't seem to have aged one bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] And you, you turned out to be rather beautiful in 
the time I haven't seen you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Huh? What... Are you an idiot? Don't make a pass at 
your sister at an offline meetup.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not making a pass at you. I'm just 
complimenting how you look more like an adult.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah yeah, siscon, siscon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] And besides, why don't you go telling your opinions 
about appearance to that witch over there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my... You mean me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Of course! What's with that getup!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] What do you mean? You know this well, the "Queen 
of Nightmare" costume.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...It's been a while since I wore this. How is it? Do I 
look better in it than I did before?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, it fits you well, almost like the real thing. But 
it's about 100 times more painful to look at.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Either way, stop cosplaying at your age!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's fine... It's fitting after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] *sigh* ...Looks aside, your sure haven't changed at 
all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Fufu... You as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] The one who's changed the most is probably you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Me? You think so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah yeah, right now you are a capable company 
president, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't tease me like that. It's not that special.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I heard from Saori that you've been working hard.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] The only thing special is the title. I still have a long 
way to go.
[FI] Yes, now I am no longer Kousaka Kyousuke...

[FI] I joined the Makishimas and took on the name of 
Makishima Kyousuke.
[FI] Also...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Father.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, what's up, Tomoka?
[FI] I have a cute daughter.

SPEAKER: SPK_TOMOKA
TEXT: [FI] Mother seems really happy, doesn't she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah.

[FI] All of her otaku friends have gathered and are 
merry.
[FI] It's a scene filled with fun and enjoyment.

[FI] What she previously wanted, and became 
desperate for, has piled up, and the results are 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURARA
TEXT: [FI] Hello...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, Kurara-san! I'm really looking forward to the 
Meruru remake!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURARA
TEXT: [FI] Ah! Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURARA
TEXT:
[FI] All the old staff have gotten together and are 
working their hardest, so please look forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I will!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Yamanashi-sensei, when will you do the maschera 
remake?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Eh!? Ummmm... C-Can you wait until your next life?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I... will wait an eternity if I need to...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] ...The fans' love... is heavy...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm sorry for leaving you with Tomo.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It's fine, no worries. There are a lot of people you 
haven't seen in a while, right? Go talk to them all.

SPEAKER: SPK_TOMOKA
TEXT: [FI] That's right, please do not worry about us, Mother.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] See?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Thank you, Kyousuke-san, Tomo-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_TOMOKA
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Hey, Kirino. Looking at this child, it's certain there 
exists a way to keep one's memories of their past 
life after reincarnating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] As expected of Saori's daughter... Tomo-chan's 
mental age and communication level are way past 
a five year-old's.

[FI] Then, Kanata, who was entangled by Kuroneko 
earlier, casually sneaked over to us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Hey hey, Saori-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Kanata-san. Are you enjoying yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
[FI] Of course. Even now I'm enjoying having passionate 
discussions with my fans.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That sounds great.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, there has been something I've been curious 
about for a while, but can I ask?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] What happened to my glasses?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I gave them away, quite some time ago.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm... not sure who has them now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Then, that's fine.
[FI] Kanata smiled with satisfaction.

[FI] Yes... Saori no longer needs to use those magic 
glasses.
[FI] As of now, she no longer needs them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, that offline meetup is getting pumped.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, we can't lose to them.
[FI] Those glasses are surely continuing to give-

SPEAKER: SPK_GIRL
TEXT:
[FI] Now! Everyone! Let us begin our first offline 
meetup!
[FI] -that first step of courage to someone out there.
